environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EC2 instance in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway. The instance has a public IP and the service is exposed via an Application Load Balancer with a public DNS name. Security group allows inbound TCP/3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. The EC2 instance has an IAM instance profile with IMDS v1 enabled (hop limit 1, HttpTokens: optional). No outbound traffic restrictions on the security group.
